antibody-humanizer v0.1.0

- Initial release with core antibody humanization functionalities.
- Supports CDR identification using Kabat, Chothia, and IMGT schemes.
- Matches murine antibody frameworks to optimal human germline templates.
- Predicts essential back-mutations for antigen binding retention.
- Provides multi-factor humanization scoring and immunogenicity assessment.
- Enables batch processing of multiple antibody candidates.
